Card Q&A.a: No, this card's [End of Opponent’s Turn] effect does not allow ignoring digivolution requirements, so you can only digivolve into a card that meets the digivolution requirements.
Card Q&A.q: Can I use this card's [End of Opponent’s Turn] effect to digivolve into a Digimon card with [Dex] or [DeathX] in its name in the trash regardless of its digivolution requirements?

Effect: [Your Turn] When effects place Tamer cards in your Digimon's digivolution cards, by suspending this Tamer, gain 1 memory.

[End of Opponent's Turn] [Once Per Turn] If this Tamer is suspended, 1 of your Digimon with Tamer cards in its digivolution cards may digivolve into a Digimon card with [Dex] or [DeathX] in its name in the trash without paying the cost.
Security Effect: [Security] Play this card without paying the cost.
